concept.title: People in or seeking work
concept.shortdesc: Unemployed people and jobseekers, along with professionals who deliver or refer to services.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Workers and practitioners who use or deliver a service in a professional capacity, such as referrers, support workers, facilitators and other professionals.
: Unemployed and economically inactive people, jobseekers and people who have lost their job or face barriers to getting into work.
